about: Players who have announced or completed their retirement. They are left out of player tables, Elo positions and comparisons, but their matches stay in the history, in other players' results and ratings, and in every backtest. Matched by tour and canonical id; the export checks the name too. Add a player only with a published source.

players.name: Stan Wawrinka
players.note: Retired after the Swiss Indoors, Basel.
